name: CFEval
intro: CFEval 是 Qwen3-VL 技术报告中与 LiveCodeBench v6、OJBench 并列的代码评测。报告对文本类评测统一披露最大输出长度 32,768 token，但只给出 CFEval 数值分数，未披露其任务来源、规模、运行环境、评估器或评分公式，也未找到独立论文或公开数据集。
eval_feature: 仅公开报告表格中的原始分数与共享最大输出长度32,768 token；CFEval任务与评分协议未披露
drawio_review_note: CONSERVATIVE REDRAW bounded to arXiv:2511.21631v2 Section 5.11 and Qwen3-VL repository snapshot 96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da. The report classifies CFEval as a coding benchmark beside LiveCodeBench v6 and OJBench, reports raw numeric results, and states a shared text-centric maximum output length of 32,768 tokens. No standalone CFEval paper, official dataset, task composition, task count, source, language, split policy, runtime, tools, CFEval-specific sampling settings, evaluator, correctness rubric, score unit, or aggregation formula was identified. The diagram exposes only the 32,768-token maximum and marks every other protocol element as undisclosed; it makes no Codeforces or rating inference.
eval_feature_en: Only Raw Scores and a Shared 32,768-token Maximum Output Length Are Public; CFEval Task and Scoring Protocol Not Disclosed
intro_en: CFEval is a coding benchmark listed in the Qwen3-VL technical report beside LiveCodeBench v6 and OJBench. The report discloses a shared maximum output length of 32,768 tokens for text-centric evaluation and provides CFEval numeric scores, but not its task source, scale, runtime, evaluator, or score formula; no standalone paper or public dataset was identified.
